cuts.scene: Claymation kitchen, medium close-up. The wife rabbit is standing at the counter, mid-motion, quick, doing two things at once, holding a cracked egg with yellow yolk running down her paws, exasperated expression.
Claymation kitchen, medium close-up. The husband sloth stands next to the counter, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed, sipping tea with an expressionless dry face.

cuts.line: 이건 뭐야, 언제 왔어, 왜 냅둬?
cuts.scene: Claymation kitchen, medium close-up. The wife rabbit grabs a small clay tool pushed on the counter, mid-motion, quick, doing two things at once, ears twitching in rapid curiosity.
Claymation kitchen, medium close-up. The wife rabbit cracks an egg over the real product, yellow yolk resting intact inside the separator while white drips neatly below, mouth open in fast surprise.
Claymation kitchen, medium close-up. The husband sloth watches without moving a muscle, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed, delivering a dry punchline with deadpan eyes.
Claymation studio background, medium close-up. The guide cock character stands beside a floating product card of the real product with a pending stamp, holding a pointer stick, sharp and cheerful.
Claymation kitchen drawer area, medium close-up. The wife rabbit rummages into an open kitchen drawer, mid-motion, quick, tossing kitchen gadgets aside frantically.
Claymation kitchen counter, medium close-up, looping back to cut 1. The husband sloth stands at the counter, very slow, barely moving, mid-blink, relaxed, calmly staring into the distance.
